content.title: Ventricular arrhythmias
content.ocr_text: ICD therapy is recommended to reduce sudden cardiac death in patients with symptomatic HF (NYHA Class II–III) and LVEF ≤35% despite optimal medical therapy for >3 months and at least 6 weeks after MI who are expected to survive for at least 1 year with good functional status.
content.recommendation_summary: Implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) therapy recommended to reduce sudden cardiac death in selected patients with symptomatic heart failure.
indication_criteria: Symptomatic heart failure, NYHA Class II–III
Persistent low LVEF despite ≥3 months of optimal medical therapy
Expected to survive ≥ 1 year with good functional status
content.other_notes: Earlier line in the document notes 'NOACs are the preferred drugs' (references cited).
